response.sql: WITH filtered_payments AS (SELECT p.payment_id, p.rental_id, p.amount, r.inventory_id, i.store_id FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 AND p.rental_id IS NOT NULL), per_rental_aggregates AS (SELECT rental_id, store_id, SUM(amount) as rental_sum, COUNT(*) as payment_count FROM filtered_payments GROUP BY rental_id, store_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_sum) as avg_rental_sum, AVG(payment_count) as avg_payment_count FROM per_rental_aggregates GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: 4.99 as payment-amount cutoff means amount >= 4.99 (keep payments at or above the threshold); alternative is amount > 4.99 (strictly above)

alternatives.interpretation: If cutoff means strictly greater than 4.99
